subject: LSO
name: Lesotho
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. IDs are TL:<subject>:<measure>:<vintage> and stable across builds: a changed value under the same ID is an upstream revision (recorded in the ledger at /ledger); a new observed year is a new claim. A null or absent figure mints no claim — absence is never zero. Scheme: https://terralore.co/integrity

claims.title: San rock art of the Maloti-Drakensberg
claims.summary: San hunter-gatherers occupy the mountain rock shelters, leaving one of the world's richest bodies of rock art depicting eland, dance and trance.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-8000bce-san-rock-art-of-the-maloti-drakensberg, claim TL:LSO:event:8000bce:san-rock-art-of-the-maloti-drakensberg, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sotho-Tswana settlement
claims.summary: Bantu-speaking Sotho-Tswana farmers and herders settle the region, bringing cattle, cultivation and iron-working alongside earlier San and Khoekhoe peoples.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1000-sotho-tswana-settlement, claim TL:LSO:event:1000:sotho-tswana-settlement, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Dispersed Sotho chiefdoms
claims.summary: Numerous small, rivalrous Sotho-speaking chiefdoms occupy the highveld and mountains, with no single overarching authority.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1700-dispersed-sotho-chiefdoms, claim TL:LSO:event:1700:dispersed-sotho-chiefdoms, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Moshoeshoe occupies Thaba Bosiu
claims.summary: Moshoeshoe I settles the defensible mountain of Thaba Bosiu, the stronghold from which he gathers difaqane refugees into the Basotho nation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1824-moshoeshoe-occupies-thaba-bosiu, claim TL:LSO:event:1824:moshoeshoe-occupies-thaba-bosiu, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Paris missionaries arrive
claims.summary: Moshoeshoe invites the Paris Evangelical Missionary Society into his kingdom; the missionaries help create a written Sesotho and advise him on dealings with Europeans.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1833-paris-missionaries-arrive, claim TL:LSO:event:1833:paris-missionaries-arrive, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Senekal's War with the Orange Free State
claims.summary: Conflict erupts with the Boers of the Orange Free State over land in the western lowlands, the first of the Free State–Basotho Wars.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1858-senekal-s-war-with-the-orange-free-state, claim TL:LSO:event:1858:senekal-s-war-with-the-orange-free-state, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Seqiti War and loss of the lowlands
claims.summary: A devastating war with the Orange Free State sees Boer commandos overrun much of the fertile western lowlands and besiege Thaba Bosiu.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1865-seqiti-war-and-loss-of-the-lowlands, claim TL:LSO:event:1865:seqiti-war-and-loss-of-the-lowlands, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Basutoland declared a British protectorate
claims.summary: Britain takes Moshoeshoe's kingdom under its protection, halting Boer absorption and fixing the borders that broadly survive as modern Lesotho.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1868-basutoland-declared-a-british-protectorate, claim TL:LSO:event:1868:basutoland-declared-a-british-protectorate, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Convention of Aliwal North
claims.summary: The boundary settlement with the Orange Free State confirms the loss of the fertile western lowlands, the "Conquered Territory", to the Boers.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1869-convention-of-aliwal-north, claim TL:LSO:event:1869:convention-of-aliwal-north, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Annexation to the Cape Colony
claims.summary: Basutoland is annexed to the Cape Colony without Basotho consent, beginning a deeply unpopular period of colonial rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1871-annexation-to-the-cape-colony, claim TL:LSO:event:1871:annexation-to-the-cape-colony, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Gun War
claims.summary: The Basotho rebel against Cape disarmament and taxation; they retain their guns and effectively repudiate Cape authority.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1880-the-gun-war, claim TL:LSO:event:1880:the-gun-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Return to direct British rule
claims.summary: Unable to control the territory, the Cape gives it up; Basutoland reverts to direct rule from Britain under a resident commissioner.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1884-return-to-direct-british-rule, claim TL:LSO:event:1884:return-to-direct-british-rule, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kept out of the Union of South Africa
claims.summary: On the formation of the Union, Basutoland is excluded as a British High Commission Territory rather than incorporated into South Africa.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1910-kept-out-of-the-union-of-south-africa, claim TL:LSO:event:1910:kept-out-of-the-union-of-south-africa, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Migrant labour to South Africa
claims.summary: With little arable land, large numbers of Basotho men become migrant workers on South African farms and gold mines, and remittances become central to the economy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1900-migrant-labour-to-south-africa, claim TL:LSO:event:1900:migrant-labour-to-south-africa, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Basotho National Party wins the pre-independence election
claims.summary: Leabua Jonathan's BNP narrowly defeats the Basutoland Congress Party, positioning him to lead the territory to independence.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1965-basotho-national-party-wins-the-pre, claim TL:LSO:event:1965:basotho-national-party-wins-the-pre, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence as the Kingdom of Lesotho
claims.summary: Basutoland becomes the independent Kingdom of Lesotho under King Moshoeshoe II and Prime Minister Leabua Jonathan, ending British rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1966-independence-as-the-kingdom-of-lesotho, claim TL:LSO:event:1966:independence-as-the-kingdom-of-lesotho, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Constitution suspended after lost election
claims.summary: Having apparently lost the first post-independence election, Leabua Jonathan annuls the result, suspends the constitution and rules by decree.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1970-constitution-suspended-after-lost-election, claim TL:LSO:event:1970:constitution-suspended-after-lost-election, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Military coup and the water treaty
claims.summary: A military coup overthrows Jonathan; in the same year the new government signs the treaty launching the Lesotho Highlands Water Project with South Africa.

sources.label: The Lesotho Highlands Water Project is 40 years old and going strong

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1986-military-coup-and-the-water-treaty, claim TL:LSO:event:1986:military-coup-and-the-water-treaty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Death of Moshoeshoe II
claims.summary: After exile and a brief restoration, King Moshoeshoe II dies in a car accident; his son Letsie III returns to the throne.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1996-death-of-moshoeshoe-ii, claim TL:LSO:event:1996:death-of-moshoeshoe-ii, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Disputed election and SADC intervention
claims.summary: A contested election sparks unrest and a South African-led SADC military intervention; much of Maseru is left in ruins.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1998-disputed-election-and-sadc-intervention, claim TL:LSO:event:1998:disputed-election-and-sadc-intervention, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Katse and Mohale dams completed
claims.summary: The Katse Dam (Phase 1A) and then the Mohale Dam are completed, sending Lesotho's mountain water to South Africa's Vaal system in exchange for royalties.

sources.label: The Lesotho Highlands Water Project is 40 years old and going strong
Lesotho Highlands Water Project II — environmental and social assessment

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Lesotho: From Thaba Bosiu to the Mountain Kingdom", terralore.co/country/LSO/chronicle#ev-1998-katse-and-mohale-dams-completed, claim TL:LSO:event:1998:katse-and-mohale-dams-completed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
